_why: End selftest_stale is 200 because dirs cross the one-day line during a run: 171 did in one 10-minute run after the sweep had finished. Lines between a cleaner that keeps up and one that does not: start reads before any work, end reads what the run left. Over a line, the reaper writes sanity.json and the Dispatcher raises it to the Conductor log; ops_watch files or reopens one fixed item per end. The pool's own cap comes from scratch_clone, not from here. Start lines are the wildly-dirty ones, set near twice a quiet machine: 2026-11-01 it was 14,199 stale fixtures, and 16 clones at 94 GB in rm/scratch that the pool cap cannot see. End lines are what a finished run may honestly leave: young work, and refusals with a real reason.
